coordinates.note: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap geocoder) centroid of the KEK campus polygon (OSM way 100702753, about 1.8 km across); campus-grade only. The 3 km TRISTAN ring and its four experimental halls are not individually located by any source consulted here.

name: KEK Tsukuba campus
notes: Campus point only. The existing site:kek-tsukuba-belle-ii is the KEKB/Belle Tsukuba hall footprint and is not used for the TRISTAN experiments, because no fetched source says which TRISTAN hall each experiment occupied.

summary.plain: The campus of the High Energy Accelerator Research Organization in Tsukuba, Japan, where the TRISTAN electron-positron collider ran from 1986 to 1995 before its tunnel was reused for KEKB.
summary.technical: KEK Tsukuba campus (Oho, Tsukuba, Ibaraki); geocoder (OpenStreetMap/Nominatim) campus-polygon centroid, about 1 km precision; the TRISTAN main ring tunnel (3016 m) lies within the campus and was reused for KEKB.
